item1_adjudication.reasoning: The owner's 2026-09-23 directive (recorded verbatim in plan §0a; echoed in CYCLE_REGISTRY write_token 'register:STOCKS-AMIHUD-RETEST-V1:owner directive 2026-09-23 STOCKS-AMIHUD-IDENTITY-EXECUTION-') lawfully substitutes the interactive typed GO for THIS cycle only. (1) Authority order #1 (handbook §3): the latest explicit owner command outranks the plan (layer 2) and the operating contract/handbook (layer 3) where P-8 lives. The directive is a command, not a probe (§2.5): 'tôi muốn bạn tự làm tới cuối nếu các gate cho phép, không hỏi tôi thêm một GO chỉ để tiếp tục công việc này' — imperative, right target, right scope. (2) P-8's letter (handbook §19.3, RULES §1) regulates the PHRASE ARTIFACT: a phrase typed early is intent and dies unconsumed; phrases never carry across cycles or pauses. The owner did NOT pre-type 'GO STOCKS AMIHUD RETEST V1 SCORED EXECUTION' — the registry still holds REGISTERED_NOT_CONSUMED and the plan forbids any agent from typing it. P-8 nowhere says an owner standing authorization may not exist; it says the phrase is the default instrument. (3) The repo's own law legitimizes exactly this instrument: handbook §2.5's canonical example of owner authority is itself a conditional standing directive ('Nếu prelaunch PASS thì chạy cells' — run the cells after prelaunch PASS); handbook §27.5 records a standing delegation ('Bạn tự do push', 2026-09-11) codified with discipline. (4) Decisive on-point precedent: RULES §7 GO-phrase registry records that 'GO FOREX NG1 SCORED EXECUTION' was CONSUMED at its own gate 2026-09-11 as a lawful two-key launch — 'A7 v3 AUTHORIZED + Lead exercising the owner standing delegation verbatim; 6/6 scored cells ran' — under plans/PLAN_forex_ng1.md §0 'Standing GO delegation (P-8 adaptation)': owner standing directive, scoped (no S1/main/purchases/signups/live-paper), triggered ONLY after independent A7 publishes AUTHORIZED, 'A7 REFUSED => no GO'. That consumption was recorded as valid repo law, the cycle ran and closed, and no incident was raised. The RETEST directive satisfies the same template, and the plan is STRICTER in form than FOREX-NG1 (no agent ever types the phrase; the recorded directive itself is the owner key). (5) Anti-laundering structural check — what P-8 exists to prevent is the agent deciding what only the owner may decide, or running without an independent audit. Both are structurally preserved: the owner has pre-decided exactly the conditional the interaction exists to let the owner decide (gates pass AND A7 authorizes THEN run to the end), A7's fresh prelaunch verdict remains a MANDATORY independent key (plan §7 phase E: run 'ONLY IF A7 authorizes BOTH the gates AND the §11 substitution'), scope is capped at the 3 named cells on the named folds, every boundary is restated in the directive itself (no S1/orders/paper/live/purchases), the fail-closed branch is self-contained (if P-8 admits no exception: stop at the gate, report the obstacle exactly, never self-create/fake the GO, never launder scored PnL as 'diagnostic'), and the owner EXPLICITLY commissioned this A7 adjudication ('yêu cầu A7 độc lập xét rõ liệu nó có thể thay thế GO tương tác theo luật repo hay không'). This is the owner pre-structuring their own gate, not agent-manufactured convenience. (6) §24 remediation law is satisfied by the same instrument: a post-scoring rerun requires an owner-approved remediation plan + new identity — the directive IS the owner-approved remediation (owner-named cycle STOCKS-AMIHUD-IDENTITY-EXECUTION-RETEST-V1) and the identity is new (new cycle_id, RETEST-* cell IDs, predecessor 3 cells immutable and already counted at stocks 45/45, program 260/263 per P-9). The fail-closed default (INTERACTIVE_GO_STILL_REQUIRED) was weighed and rejected because the authority question is not uncertain: layer-1 owner command + §2.5/§27.5 law + the recorded FOREX-NG1 consumption precedent all point one way; uncertainty was confined to record authenticity, which is handled by binding condition B8 rather than by overriding a well-recorded owner command.
binding_conditions: B1 (A7 key survives): the standing directive substitutes ONLY the owner key. The later fresh-context A7 prelaunch audit must itself authorize the cycle (zero unresolved HIGH/CRITICAL) — plan §7 phase E runs 'ONLY IF A7 authorizes BOTH the gates AND the §11 substitution'; A7 refusal => no run, STOPPED/BLOCKED state reported.

B2 (scope ceiling absolute): exactly RETEST-ILLIQ21 / RETEST-ILLIQ63 / RETEST-REVERSAL5 on folds F1=2019 / F2=2020 / F3=2021-22; any different arm, extra cell, or different fold voids the substitution and requires a fresh interactive owner GO.

B3 (boundaries absolute): S1 SEALED_UNTOUCHED; no orders/paper/testnet/live; no purchases or new entitlements; no credentials in logs; predecessor artifacts immutable; SANDBOX-OVERFIT-3ASSETS never read; machine-wide heavy lock held for scored runs.

B4 (no laundering): every computed outcome counts in the observed denominator, is committed, and is labeled OUTCOME_OBSERVED_RETROSPECTIVE_RETEST with R0_NOT_RUN ancestry on every artifact; scored PnL is never called 'diagnostic', never untouched OOS, never self-promoted; a P0 close with zero scored cells is a valid result.

B5 (fail-closed at every gate): any gate FAIL/NOT_RUN/blocker => STOP at that gate with truthful NOT_RUN/BLOCKED vocabulary (incl. STOPPED_GATE_INTERACTIVE_GO_REQUIRED, BLOCKED_EXECUTION, BLOCKED_DATA_OR_IDENTITY, BLOCKED_PRELAUNCH); the GO phrase is never typed by an agent, never fabricated.

B6 (phrase remains owner-reserved): the typed phrase 'GO STOCKS AMIHUD RETEST V1 SCORED EXECUTION' is not extinguished or pre-consumed by this adjudication; if the owner later chooses to type it, it is consumed only at this cycle's own gate per P-8.

B7 (no precedent beyond this cycle): this adjudication binds ONLY STOCKS-AMIHUD-RETEST-V1's E phase; every future cycle's GO question is fresh (P-8 no-carryover); it sets no standing rule for other cycles.

B8 (record-dependence): the substitution's authority is the RECORDED directive text (plan §0a verbatim anchors + registry write_token). If that record is shown to diverge from the owner's actual words, the substitution falls and the interactive GO is required.

checklist.title: B1 extreme-print law (uniform, ex ante, artifact coverage, tradability justification)
checklist.evidence: |adj_t/adj_{t-1} - 1| >= 9 excluded from ALL formations AND never a fill bar, reason-coded C8, frozen in the plan BEFORE any new PnL. Catches all measured artifacts: HTV +9,594x, UNT 903x, NCS 9.5x, IOMT 199x — all >> 9, so the threshold value (9 vs 10 vs 50) is immaterial for the known artifacts; the tighter threshold removes MORE data (conservative, not beauty-enhancing). Losing legitimate extreme movers from formations is an accepted conservative cost, stated in §3. Justification is tradability/order-of-magnitude (a >=900% single-session adjusted move is effectively untradable in an adjusted-open model), not outcome-tuning. NOTE (see F-2): as written the law catches UP-jumps only (|r|>=9 means ratio >=10x); a symmetric down-10x (ratio <=0.1, |r|=0.9) would pass B1 — consistent with the MEASURED evidence class (forward splits verified smooth 4/4 in dollar_volume_contract; the pathology class C4 is up-jumps) but §3's 'order-of-magnitude' wording overstates symmetry; scope must be pinned in the D-phase impl contract.

findings.title: Q1 quarantine sweep magnitude has no pre-frozen stop trigger
findings.detail: Q1's conjunction can legitimately sweep many names (EDGAR company_tickers.json is a CURRENT-tickers map, so essentially every delisted name is 'EDGAR-current-absent'; the >=20 shared-death-batch disjunct may catch clustered legitimate delistings). The plan makes the sweep auditable (I4 manifest, counts, universe_retest_frozen.json) but does not pre-freeze a magnitude bound or an automatic BLOCKED_DATA_OR_IDENTITY trigger if the quarantined fraction transforms the universe. Risk is survivorship-flavored distortion of the cross-section without a gate noticing. Binding: the fresh A7 prelaunch audit must verify the quarantine rate, per-reason counts, and that the surviving universe is not one-sided; a sweep that materially transforms the predecessor universe is an unresolved HIGH at prelaunch until adjudicated.

findings.title: B1 threshold is asymmetric vs its own 'order-of-magnitude' description
findings.detail: |r_adj| >= 9 catches up-jumps (ratio >= ~10x) only; a symmetric down-10x bar (ratio <= 0.1, |r| = 0.9) would pass B1 and could still feed ILLIQ terms or act as a fill bar. This matches the MEASURED evidence class (C4: vendor adj is smooth across forward splits 4/4, pathology is reverse-split up-jumps) so it is evidence-directed, but §3's 'order-of-magnitude single-session move' wording overstates the coverage. The exact predicate (and whether the down side is in or out of scope) must be pinned verbatim in the D-phase impl contract before any PnL, and the residual risk disclosed in §8 if left asymmetric.

findings.title: Q3 'pairwise' semantics for >2-code ISIN groups unpinned
findings.detail: For an ISIN group with >2 staged codes the plan does not state whether ALL pairs must clear corr>=0.999 on >=200 common bars or any pair suffices for group membership (corr is not strictly transitive). Common-bar denominators also vary by pair. Deterministic outcomes require the exact algorithm (pairing order, common-bar window, all-pairs vs any-pairs, transitive-closure vs star-vs-lexicographic-first) pinned in the D-phase impl contract before any PnL; divergence found after PnL is an incident per the impl-contract law.
